blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Economy, Planning and Development (DepDev) is set to prioritize the Metro Manila ecosystem in its 30-year infrastructure roadmap as the government seeks to prevent further delays caused by fragmented plans that are repeatedly revised when administrations change.
